criteria.name: section_coverage
criteria.reason: All main sections are covered except Acknowledgements and References.

criteria.name: concision
criteria.reason: Most sections are concise, with some slightly longer descriptions that could be more succinct.

criteria.name: faithfulness
criteria.reason: The summary accurately reflects the content of the paper without any hallucinations.

criteria.name: writing_quality
criteria.reason: Generally clear and coherent; minor improvements in flow could be made.

overall_reason: The summary is comprehensive and accurate, demonstrating strong understanding and effective communication.
